title: Quina 7136: Jackpot Reaches 25 Million
subtitle: Understand what happened in draw 7135 and what is at stake in the upcoming draw
excerpt: In Quina draw 7135, no bets matched all five numbers, rolling the top prize over to 25 million for draw 7136.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Quina draw 7135, held on Monday evening (5), had no tickets matching all five numbers (quina). As a result, the main prize rolled over and is estimated at R$ 25 million for the next draw, numbered 7136.

Results of Draw 7135

Draw 7135 registered 88 winning bets for four numbers (quadra), with each earning a prize of R$ 7,140.38. Among them, five bets from Paraná were rewarded, with payouts ranging from R$ 7,140.38 to R$ 21,421.05. A syndicate ticket from Florianópolis, with eight participants, won R$ 42,842.24.

How Quina Payouts Work

Prizes are awarded to bets matching 2 to 5 numbers (duque, terno, quadra, and quina). The prize pool is divided as follows: 35% for matching 5 numbers, 15% for the quadra, 10% for the terno, and 10% for the duque.

Upcoming Draw 7136

With no quina winners in draw 7135, the top prize of R$ 25 million will be up for grabs in draw 7136, which will take place on Tuesday (6) at 9:00 p.m.

How to Bet

To participate, players must select between 5 and 15 numbers out of the 80 available. The minimum bet, with 5 numbers, costs R$ 3.00. Bets can be placed until 7:00 p.m. at accredited lottery outlets or through Caixa Econômica Federal's digital channels (website and app).

Claiming Prizes

Gross prizes up to R$ 2,428.80 can be collected at any lottery outlet or transferred to Mercado Pago if the bet was placed online. Higher amounts must be redeemed in person at Caixa branches upon presenting a valid photo ID, CPF, and the original ticket. Prizes equal to or exceeding R$ 10,000 are paid within two business days following the request.

With information from G1, ISTOÉ DINHEIRO.
